description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver for WorldSemi WS2812B individually-addressable LEDs using SPI interface.

classes.name: ws2812b_led
classes.description: Represents a multi-color LED with cascade index.

classes.name: ws2812b_priv
classes.description: Private data structure for the driver, including SPI device, mutex, LED data buffer, and array of LEDs.

methods.name: ws2812b_set_byte
methods.description: Converts a byte of data into 3-byte SPI data representing pulses for WS2812B protocol.

methods.name: ws2812b_set
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the LED by preparing SPI data and transmitting it.

methods.name: ws2812b_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates resources, reads device tree properties, and registers LEDs.
